TaskDescription: 43 Hz high-frequency electrical stimulation (alternating polarity pulses) of contacts D08-D09 in the right posterior temporal periventricular nodular heterotopia, at 0.25-0.6 mA, with clinical testing; autoscopic hallucinations (body perception) were elicited at >=0.5 mA (marker labels). High-frequency stimulation with alternating polarity pulses was used to identify the network time-locked to the clinical effect (symptom-related effective connectivity); autoscopic hallucinations mainly involved the face and upper trunk (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract).
iEEGReference: n/a (not stated in the release; signals as exported by the authors in AnyWave ADES format)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinical SEEG exploration of drug-resistant epilepsy: depth electrodes covering the right posterior temporal periventricular nodular heterotopia and the adjacent cortex (Bratu et al. 2021, Cortex 145:285-294, doi:10.1016/j.cortex.2021.08.018, abstract), plus left-hemisphere electrodes F', X', Y' (Contact_coordinates.xlsx).
iEEGElectrodeGroups: 16 depth electrodes, 246 contacts with coordinates: I: 12 contacts (R); A: 15 contacts (R); B: 15 contacts (R); F: 15 contacts (R); L: 15 contacts (R); D: 18 contacts (R); Q: 18 contacts (R); K: 18 contacts (R); U: 12 contacts (R); X': 18 contacts (L); Y': 18 contacts (L); F': 12 contacts (L); R: 12 contacts (R); P: 15 contacts (R); C: 15 contacts (R); S: 18 contacts (R)
ElectricalStimulationParameters: Stimulation events as labelled in the AnyWave markers: 43Hz D08-D09 0.25mA; NS; 43Hz D08-D09 0.5mA; body perception; 43Hz D08-D09 0.6mA; body perception
